column1: Purpose: Tracks every April transaction and rolls it up into daily totals, entity breakdowns, and a monthly summary. Everything is calculated from the Transaction Log at the bottom of this sheet.
1. Every column in the daily table below calculates automatically from this month’s Transaction Log at the bottom of the sheet.
2. Add a row to the Transaction Log for every transaction.
3. Pick the Entity, Transaction Type, Category, and Currency from each row’s dropdowns.
4. To rename your entities, change D16 and E16 on the January tab. Every other month tab and every Entity dropdown follows automatically.
5. Income by Entity, Expenses by Entity, and Monthly Summary further down the sheet also calculate automatically from the Transaction Log.
